title: Plumeform glass panel
description: A 28px-radius translucent white panel with a lit edge and long soft drop, floating over blurred mint, sky and peach clouds that drift on a slow loop and rise as the panel scrolls past. Holds a media slot (placeholder when empty) or built content.
notes: best on light pages; the clouds use chart-2…4 and glow
cloud drift is a CSS view timeline; the float loop and drift stop under reduced motion
name: plumeform-panel

props.name: media
props.description: a picture, video or live demo for the panel; empty shows a placeholder of `aspect`

props.name: children
props.description: built content instead of media (e.g. a form); fills the padded panel

props.name: padding
props.description: inner padding: none lets media run to the panel's edge
